classical_inverse.algorithm: Search all 32 branch histories, rebuild the normalized basis and ranks, decode the samples, then accept only a history whose forward recurrence reproduces the supplied compact state.
classical_inverse.scope: Tests the constructive classical decoder on all GF(8) collision inputs and 64 sampled valid GF(2^12) inputs; it does not prove all GF(2^12) states.

decision: The one-bit tag resolves the GF(8) compact-state collisions, and a classical five-pivot inverse decodes all collision cases plus the sampled GF(2^12) cases. This remains classical evidence; no reversible tag eraser, resource schedule, or official verifier result is established.

gf12_dqi_sample.scope: 64 sampled valid error patterns at weights 31 and 35; compatibility evidence only, not a full-domain proof.

gf8_exhaustive.scope: Exhaustive classical information check over all five-word GF(8) inputs.

promotion_gate: The inverse is classical only. Build its reversible circuit and compact-state/tag eraser, then require Q <= 890, mean T <= 215175.987 at R=1.1912605, the complete 4+66 schedule, and official-verifier PASS.
